name: gnomAD rare vs common enrichment in the deleterious tail, odds ratio (GPN-MSA Supplementary Table 4)
description: Odds ratio of rare versus common gnomAD variants among the variants a score places in its deleterious tail, the tail threshold set so that each score makes 30 false discoveries.

attributes.protocol: Each model or score is applied zero-shot (no training on these labels). Variants are ranked by score; the deleterious tail is cut where the score makes 30 false discoveries (common variants), and the odds ratio of rare versus common variants in the tail is computed with a one-sided Fisher's exact test. All variant types, with rare variants subsampled to match the number of common variants. For each ablation setting three replicate models with different seeds were trained where applicable; the table prints the mean and the maximum over seeds.
limitations: Benchmark built and run by the GPN-MSA authors (author-reported).
The caption says 'same approach as Figure 2d'; in v2 the gnomAD enrichment panel is Figure 2f (the caption's figure letters are off by two, as for the other columns).

Variant counts and p-values are not printed in Supplementary Table 4.
